input_refs.description: Exactly one authorized original content_hash for edit; none for generation.

mode.description: generate (default), edit, or result; editing never falls back to generation.

prompt.description: Description of the requested generation or edit. Required except for result retrieval.

size.description: Optional image size, e.g. 1024x1024, 1792x1024, 1024x1792. Leave empty to use the provider default.

task_id.description: Existing task_id for mode=result; never starts a model request.
